name: Internal Notice of Child Abuse Report Filed
description: After a report is made, the reporter notifies the principal (with the report confirmation), and the principal immediately notifies the Superintendent.
recipient: Building principal or administrator; Superintendent or designee
deadline: immediately after making the initial report
quote: The building principal or administrator shall then immediately notify the Superintendent or designee that a child abuse report has been made and if the initial report was made electronically, also provide a copy of the report confirmation.
